args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the Hawaii vacation plans

Destination: Hawaii
Dates: June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Activities:
  - Beach day at Waikiki Beach
  - Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay
  - Hiking at Diamond Head
  - Road trip to the North Shore
  - Luau experience
  - Relaxation day
  - Kayaking
  - Shopping

Essential Items:
  - Swimwear (2-3 suits)
  - Sunscreen (high SPF)
  - Hiking gear (backpack, water bottle, hiking boots)
  - Casual outfits (lightweight clothing)
  - Camera
  - Travel documents (passport, driver's license)
  - Comfortable walking shoes
  - Light jacket (evenings can be cool)
  - Beach towel
  - Snorkeling gear
  - Water bottle
  - Beach bag
  - Sunglasses
  - Reef-safe sunscreen
  - Power adapter
  - Phone charger
  - Wallet
  - Cash
  - Travel insurance documents

Additional Hawaii-specific items:
  - Insect repellent
  - Water shoes
  - Beach umbrella
  - Snorkeling mask
  - Fins
  - Snorkeling vest
  - Water bottle refillable

Created: June 26, 2024

Shared with: john.doe@gmail.com (read permission)
